mephala: Mephala trained in Erathia's military and showed a genius for using terrain to her advantage in battle. Several years ago, she resigned her commission, preferring AvLee's quiet serenity to the bustle of Erathia's cities instead.
ryland: Ryland was the first human—and to date the only one—fully accepted by AvLee's Circle of Elder Dendroids as a Ranger. Some joke that he was once an Elf, killed and accidentally reincarnated into a human body.
gem: Gem was one of Enroth's greatest Sorceresses, serving King Roland Ironfist during the Succession Wars. Shortly after Roland secured the throne of Enroth, Gem left for Erathia, where she found a new home in AvLee.
alagar: Alagar is rumored to have lived among Vori's Snow Elves. His command of the element of Water is unsurpassed, especially his command of ice. He has been in AvLee's service since before the Kreegan invasion.
